title: Hamilton-Zero: A Neural Tensor-Network Foundation Model for Ground States of Arbitrary Quadratic Qubit Hamiltonians
abstract: arXiv:2608.11911v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A central promise of useful quantum advantage is the ability to compute ground states of Hamiltonian systems beyond the reach of classical simulation methods. Here we demonstrate that this problem can be effectively amortized across an arbitrary and universal set of Hamiltonians by a foundation model with $\sim0.5$B variational parameters, trained with contemporary techniques from large language models and deep reinforcement learning. translated_title: Hamilton-Zero：任意二次型量子比特哈密顿量基态的神经张量网络基础模型
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11911v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：有用量子优势的核心承诺是能够计算超出经典模拟方法范围的哈密顿系统基态。在这里，我们证明这一问题可以通过一个具有约0.5B变分参数的基础模型，在任意且通用的哈密顿量集合上有效摊销，该模型使用来自大型语言模型和深度强化学习的当代技术进行训练。为此，我们将自旋-1/2量子基态学习表述为在SU(2)^N上的中心奇标量函数上的流形变分优化。这用流形函数取代了显式的希尔伯特空间向量振幅，哈密顿量通过李导数作用于这些函数，并由自定义自动微分原语进行评估。我们证明了在该流形上得到的变分原理，利用Peter-Weyl定理，保持了自旋-1/2扇区的基态上界。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于神经张量网络的基础模型，通过流形变分优化和自定义自动微分，能够高效计算任意二次型量子比特哈密顿量的基态，并严格保持能量上界。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a neural tensor-network foundation model that efficiently computes ground states of arbitrary quadratic qubit Hamiltonians via manifold variational optimization and custom automatic differentiation, while rigorously preserving the energy upper bound.
